coursework.en: The retained guideline generally allows AI and language models within examiner/instructor rules while preserving independent work. It does not offer unrestricted permission.
coursework.zh: 保留指南原则上允许在考官或教师规则内使用AI及语言模型，同时保持独立完成；这不是无限制许可。

exams.en: The same conditional framework requires checking examiner and course rules. The record does not establish that AI is allowed in every exam or discipline-specific assessment.
exams.zh: 同一条件框架要求核对考官及课程规则；本记录不能证明每场考试或专业考核都允许AI。

disclosure.en: Study-work records require an independence/AI-use declaration with tools and purposes. Prompt logs are not made a universal duty here; doctoral disclosure has separate requirements.
disclosure.zh: 学习作业记录要求提交独立完成及AI使用声明，列明工具与用途。本页不将提示词日志变成普遍义务，博士披露另有要求。

privacy_data.en: The guideline advises against entering sensitive, personal, confidential or copyrighted text into AI systems that may process it outside university infrastructure. Preserve this advisory strength and context.
privacy_data.zh: 指南建议避免向可能在校外基础设施处理内容的AI系统输入敏感、个人、保密或受版权保护文本；保留其建议力度和适用语境。

approved_tools.en: The computing-centre record describes university-hosted YoKI and model choice for members. It does not establish universal account eligibility, costs or permission for assessed use.
approved_tools.zh: 计算中心记录描述校方托管的YoKI及成员模型选择，但不据此确定普遍账户资格、费用或考核使用许可。

research_publication.en: Doctoral guidance requires stating when, where, why and to what extent AI was used. AI remains an aid to independent intellectual work; this doctoral rule is not expanded to all publication types.
research_publication.zh: 博士指引要求说明何时、何处、为何及在何种程度上使用AI。AI仍是独立智力工作的辅助，不将博士规则扩大至所有发表类型。

academic_integrity.en: Independent work and study-work disclosure remain central conditions. Neither these records nor held faculty examples establish a university-wide sanction or appeal deadline.
academic_integrity.zh: 独立完成和学习作业披露仍是核心条件；这些条款及暂缓的院系例子均未确定全校统一处分或申诉期限。

teaching_guidance.en: Instructors are asked to design AI use around learning goals and tell students which applications are permitted or prohibited. Task and examiner conditions still apply.
teaching_guidance.zh: 指引要求教师围绕学习目标设计AI使用，并告知学生允许或禁止的应用；任务与考官条件继续适用。

security_procurement.en: No retained Claim establishes a separate university-wide AI procurement process in this view. Data-entry advice and YoKI hosting should not be recast as such a process.
security_procurement.zh: 本视图保留条款未确定独立的全校AI采购流程，不将数据输入建议或YoKI托管情况改写成采购规定。

basis.evidenceSnippet: Studierende müssen für alle Studienarbeiten eine Eigenständigkeits- und Kennzeichnungserklärung abgeben, die den Einsatz von KI-Werkzeugen offenlegt. Diese Kennzeichnungspflicht gilt für Text/Textteile, Bilder, Videos und Musikstücke sowie alle anderen Elemente, für deren Erstellung KI verwendet wurde. Eine Übersicht der genutzten KI-Tools und deren Verwendungszweck ist verpflichtend.

Die Nutzung von KI und Sprachmodellen (LLMs) wie ChatGPT, DeepL oder anderen Werkzeugen ist im Studium und in der Lehre an der UHD grundsätzlich erlaubt. Die spezifische Anwendung muss mit den Prüfer:innen und Lehrenden abgestimmt werden. Zentral ist, dass ein eigenständiger Charakter der Leistung gewahrt bleibt.

Lehrende und Studierende sollten bei der Nutzung von KI darauf achten, dass keine sensiblen, personenbezogenen oder vertraulichen Daten sowie urheberrechtlich geschützte Texte/Textteile in KI-Systeme eingegeben werden, die diese Daten außerhalb der Infrastruktur der Universität Heidelberg speichern oder verarbeiten könnten.
Lehrende sind dazu angehalten, den KI-Einsatz entsprechend den Lernzielen zu gestalten und die Studierenden über erlaubte und unerlaubte Anwendungen zu informieren.

The use of AI tools must be explicitly disclosed, specifying when, where, why, and to what extent they were employed in the preparation of the dissertation. AI tools must be used as assistive instruments, not as substitutes for independent intellectual work, critical thinking, or scholarly judgment.

Um Beschäftigten, Studierenden und Forschenden einen sicheren Zugang zu generativen KI-Modellen zu gewährleisten und diese im Arbeitsalltag konstruktiv zu integrieren, entwickelt und hostet das URZ eigene KI-Intrastruktur und setzt Open-Source-Produkte ein. Über die KI-Plattform YoKI können Universitätsmitglieder aus verschiedenen großen Sprachmodellen auswählen.

disclosure.en: Study-work records require an independence/AI-use declaration with tools and purposes. Prompt logs are not made a universal duty here; doctoral disclosure has separate requirements.
disclosure.zh: 学习作业记录要求提交独立完成及AI使用声明，列明工具与用途。本页不将提示词日志变成普遍义务，博士披露另有要求。
disclosure.meaningEn: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

privacy_data.en: The guideline advises against entering sensitive, personal, confidential or copyrighted text into AI systems that may process it outside university infrastructure. Preserve this advisory strength and context.
privacy_data.zh: 指南建议避免向可能在校外基础设施处理内容的AI系统输入敏感、个人、保密或受版权保护文本；保留其建议力度和适用语境。
privacy_data.meaningEn: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 中央导向框架仍受考官、教师与独立完成条件约束。学习作业与博士披露分别适用；YoKI可用不等于考核许可。

approved_tools.en: The computing-centre record describes university-hosted YoKI and model choice for members. It does not establish universal account eligibility, costs or permission for assessed use.
approved_tools.zh: 计算中心记录描述校方托管的YoKI及成员模型选择，但不据此确定普遍账户资格、费用或考核使用许可。
approved_tools.meaningEn: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

research_publication.en: Doctoral guidance requires stating when, where, why and to what extent AI was used. AI remains an aid to independent intellectual work; this doctoral rule is not expanded to all publication types.
research_publication.zh: 博士指引要求说明何时、何处、为何及在何种程度上使用AI。AI仍是独立智力工作的辅助，不将博士规则扩大至所有发表类型。
research_publication.meaningEn: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.
research_publication.meaningZh: 中央导向框架仍受考官、教师与独立完成条件约束。学习作业与博士披露分别适用；YoKI可用不等于考核许可。

academic_integrity.en: Independent work and study-work disclosure remain central conditions. Neither these records nor held faculty examples establish a university-wide sanction or appeal deadline.
academic_integrity.zh: 独立完成和学习作业披露仍是核心条件；这些条款及暂缓的院系例子均未确定全校统一处分或申诉期限。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.en: Instructors are asked to design AI use around learning goals and tell students which applications are permitted or prohibited. Task and examiner conditions still apply.
teaching_guidance.zh: 指引要求教师围绕学习目标设计AI使用，并告知学生允许或禁止的应用；任务与考官条件继续适用。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: The central orientation framework remains conditional on examiners, instructors and independent work. Study-work and doctoral disclosure differ; YoKI access is not assessment permission.

security_procurement.en: No retained Claim establishes a separate university-wide AI procurement process in this view. Data-entry advice and YoKI hosting should not be recast as such a process.
security_procurement.zh: 本视图保留条款未确定独立的全校AI采购流程，不将数据输入建议或YoKI托管情况改写成采购规定。
